notes: Qal's sole citation (1Chr.12.34, of Zebulun's troops) is OSHB's homonym-letter sub-sense "a" ("to arrange, as a battle... hence, to muster"), matching the lexicon's "keep (rank)" usage more precisely than "help" alone -- broadened the gloss to keep both.

Niphal has a second, attested-but-unrequested sub-sense beyond "be lacking": OSHB tags Isa.5.6 and Isa.7.25 ("it shall not be pruned nor hoed"; "which shall be hoed with the mattock") as sub-sense "b" ("to arrange... a vineyard, to hoe"), distinct from sub-sense "c" (the "be lacking/fail" forms actually requested, e.g. Isa.34.16, 40.26, Zeph.3.5). Included alongside "be lacking" per the standing rule of keeping same-number homonym-letter sub-senses together.

Qal's sole citation (1Chr.12.34) is ambiguous between "help" and "keep rank (in battle)" with no clear textual signal favoring the military-formation reading; kept the more conservative "help" (BDB's primary sense for this root) and flagging as uncertain given the single citation.
